name: io.github.JasonLandbridge/dotnet-test-runner-mcp
description: Discover, filter, and run .NET tests via MCP.
title: .NET Test Runner MCP

environmentVariables.name: WORKING_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Base directory used by tools that run dotnet commands.

environmentVariables.name: TESTS_DIRECTORY_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Relative folder name under WORKING_DIRECTORY that contains tests.

environmentVariables.name: DISABLE_CTRF
environmentVariables.description: Disable CTRF report arguments for runners without CTRF support.

environmentVariables.name: TEST_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for test execution; nonpositive values use 180 seconds.
